answer: Unrepeatable answer escrow. Each agent must answer a fresh challenge drawn from a live sensor feed at the wharf, and the reply is hashed into the next challenge, so copying a prior answer fails verification. A juniper-scented test strip photographed beside the agent's readout binds the answer to that moment, since a reusable answer cannot carry a new strip. Duplicating identities means buying and physically presenting a new strip and fresh sensor access per attempt, and one answer reused across a meadow of clones is rejected outright.
